figurative_meaning_en: Enchanted or captivated by beauty, qualities, personality, etc.
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কণ্ঠস্বরে শ্রোতারা মন্ত্রমুগ্ধ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The audience was spellbound by her voice.
Everyone was enchanted by that artwork.
note: The term draws from the concept of mantras in Indian traditions, implying a hypnotic or magical attraction.
